title: Multiple Law Enforcement agencies on scene in Pittsylvania County - NewsBreak
text: UPDATE: The Pittsylvania County Sheriff’s Office, Commonwealth’s attorney, and State Police Officials say a suspect is in custody after shooting at deputies who responded to a home in the Pittsville area to serve a warrant. According to Sheriff Mike Taylor, three deputies were trying to serve a warrant and protective order at a home on Blue Jay Lane. They were met with gunfire at the door, said the Sheriff, and immediately called for backup. Two deputies were hit with shrapnel, and one was taken to a local emergency room for their injuries “out of an abundance of caution”, said Sheriff Taylor. Multiple agencies from across the Commonwealth responded to help the manage the scene. The suspect, identified by officials as James Andreu Lehnerd, eventually surrendered and came out on his own, said State Police spokesperson, SGT. Rick Garletts. Commonwealth’s Attorney Bryan Haskins said the suspect is likely facing serious charges, though those are still being determined. You can watch their full news conference here . UPDATE – Virginia State Police has confirmed to WFXR News that a suspect is in custody. We are awaiting a news conference from officials. That is scheduled for 10:45 p.m. T his story is continuing to develop. Refresh the article for the latest updates. UPDATE – Virginia Congressman John McGuire says deputies have been shot in Pittsylvania County. “My thoughts and prayers are with the deputies who were shot in Pittsylvania County, as well as their families. We are closely following the situation and keeping everyone affected in our hearts during this difficult time.” said the 5th District Representative on the social media site X. This story is continuing to develop. Refresh the article for the latest updates. PITTSYLVANIA CO., Va (WFXR) — Law enforcement agencies from multiple surrounding localities are responding to a road in Pittsylvania County, according to eye witnesses near the scene. It was described to WFXR News reporter George Noleff as a “huge police presence” with multiple agencies responding on Pittsville Road. This story is developing. WFXR News has a crew on scene working to gather more information. Refresh for updates, as they are made available.
